Class HistoryScreen

java.lang.Object
com.view.HistoryScreen
public class HistoryScreen extends Object
Handles the expense history screen for the Masroofy application. Displays all transactions for the active budget cycle and allows the user to filter, edit, and delete transactions.

      public HistoryScreen(HistoryController historyController, int activeCycleId)
      Constructs a HistoryScreen with the given history controller and active cycle ID.
      Parameters:
      historyController - the HistoryController used to retrieve and manage transactions

  • Method Details

    • displayHistory

      public void displayHistory(List<Transaction> list)
      Renders the given list of transactions in a formatted table. Displays each transaction's ID, amount, category, timestamp, and note. Shows a message if the list is empty.
      Parameters:
      list - the list of Transaction objects to display

    • show

      public void show()
      Displays the history screen and handles user navigation. Loads all transactions for the active cycle and presents options to filter, edit, delete, refresh, or quit.

    • onFilterByCategory

      public void onFilterByCategory(int catId)
      Filters and displays transactions belonging to the specified category.
      Parameters:
      catId - the ID of the category to filter by

    • onEdit

      public void onEdit(int txId)
      Handles the edit flow for a specific transaction. Prompts the user for a new amount, category, and note, then updates the transaction via HistoryController.editTransaction(int, double, int, String). Refreshes the displayed list after a successful edit.
      Parameters:
      txId - the ID of the transaction to edit

    • onDelete

      public void onDelete(int txId)
      Handles the delete flow for a specific transaction. Asks for confirmation before deleting via HistoryController.deleteTransaction(int). Refreshes the displayed list after deletion.
      Parameters:
      txId - the ID of the transaction to delete
